description: This is a Python source file defining a FastAPI router for shopping cart operations in an e-commerce backend. It includes route definitions for fetching, adding, updating, removing, and clearing cart items, along with helper functions to build responses and extract user information.

methods.name: str get_user_id(x_user_id: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-User-Id"))
methods.description: Extracts and validates the user ID from the X-User-Id header, raising an HTTP 400 error if missing.

methods.name: CartResponse _build_cart_response(user_id: str)
methods.description: Constructs a CartResponse object containing cart items and total price based on current cart data.

methods.name: CartResponse get_cart(user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id))
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve the full contents of a user's cart, including item details and total pricing.

methods.name: None add_or_increment_cart( product_id: int = Path(..., description="Product ID to add/increment in cart"), body: dict = Body({}, example={"quantity": 1}), user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id), )
methods.description: API endpoint to add a product to the cart or increment its quantity, creating the entry if it does not exist.

methods.name: None patch_cart_quantity( product_id: int = Path(..., description="Product ID"), req: UpdateQuantityRequest = Body(...), user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id), )
methods.description: API endpoint to set a specific product's quantity in the cart, removing it if quantity < 1.

methods.name: None remove_cart_item( product_id: int = Path(..., description="Product ID"), user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id), )
methods.description: API endpoint to remove a specific product from the user's cart.

methods.name: None clear_cart_items(user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id))
methods.description: API endpoint to remove all items from the user's cart.
